name: enum4linux-ng
summary: A next generation version of enum4linux.
highlights: -A — Do all simple enumeration including nmblookup (-U -G -S -P -O -N -I -L). This option is en
-As — Do all simple short enumeration without NetBIOS names lookup (-U -G -S -P -O -I -L)
-Gm — Get groups with group members via RPC
-P — Get password policy information via RPC

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: -A
flags.description: Do all simple enumeration including nmblookup (-U -G -S -P -O -N -I -L). This option is enabled if you don't provide any other option.

flags.name: -As
flags.description: Do all simple short enumeration without NetBIOS names lookup (-U -G -S -P -O -I -L)

flags.name: -U
flags.description: Get users via RPC

flags.name: -G
flags.description: Get groups via RPC

flags.name: -Gm
flags.description: Get groups with group members via RPC

flags.name: -S
flags.description: Get shares via RPC

flags.name: -C
flags.description: Get services via RPC

flags.name: -P
flags.description: Get password policy information via RPC

flags.name: -O
flags.description: Get OS information via RPC

flags.name: -L
flags.description: Get additional domain info via LDAP/LDAPS (for DCs only)

flags.name: -I
flags.description: Get printer information via RPC

flags.name: -R
flags.description: Enumerate users via RID cycling. Optionally specify the lookup request size (BULK_SIZE).

flags.name: -N
flags.description: Do an NetBIOS names lookup (similar to nbtstat) and try to retrieve workgroup from output

flags.name: -w
flags.description: Specify workgroup/domain manually (usually found automatically)

flags.name: -u
flags.description: Specify username to use (default "")

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Specify password to use (default "")

flags.name: -K
flags.description: Try to authenticate with Kerberos, only useful in Active Directory environment (Note: DNS must be setup correctly for this option to work

flags.name: -H
flags.description: Try to authenticate with hash

flags.name: --local-auth
flags.description: Authenticate locally to target

flags.name: -d
flags.description: Get detailed information for users and groups, applies to -U, -G and -R

flags.name: -k
flags.description: User(s) that exists on remote system (default: administrator,guest,krbtgt,domain admins,root,bin,none). Used to get sid with "lookupsids"

flags.name: -r
flags.description: RID ranges to enumerate (default: 500-550,1000-1050)

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Brute force guessing for shares

flags.name: -t
flags.description: Sets connection timeout in seconds (default: 10s)

flags.name: -v
flags.description: Verbose, show full samba tools commands being run (net, rpcclient, etc.)

flags.name: --keep
flags.description: Don't delete the Samba configuration file created during tool run after enumeration (useful with -v)

flags.name: -oJ
flags.description: Writes output to JSON file (extension is added automatically)

flags.name: -oY
flags.description: Writes output to YAML file (extension is added automatically)

flags.name: -oA
flags.description: Writes output to YAML and JSON file (extensions are added automatically)
